newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel July-Oct pre-tax down 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Steel July-Oct pre-tax down 28 pct.

text.p: China Steel Corp, Taiwan's largest steel maker, said on Thursday its pre-tax profits between July and October 1996 fell 28 percent to T$5.313 billion from T$7.38 billion in the same period last year.
Its July-October sales slid to T$27.417 billion from T$29.64 billion in the same period of 1995, the firm said in a statement.
The company's pre-tax profit in October was T$1.316 billion on sales of T$6.86 billion, down from a T$1.898 billion profit and sales of T$7.444 billion, the same month a year earlier, it said.
China Steel, previously state-owned, was privatised in April 1995.
